headline_drivers: Q1 2026 earnings and guidance: Astera Labs reported revenue of $308.4M, up 93% y/y, and raised Q2 2026 guidance to $355M-$365M with EPS of $0.44-$0.46, reinforcing the Scorpio ramp and AI-infrastructure demand (reported May 2026).

Sector catalyst: ALAB has been moving with the broader AI infrastructure / semiconductor rally, with peers and the Nasdaq hitting fresh highs and semis catching a bid in late April-May 2026; this appears to be amplifying the post-earnings breakout.

Bullish sell-side / target-reset narrative: Loop Capital and other analysts have continued to frame ALAB as a key AI data-center interconnect name, with some reports citing targets as high as $250-$250+ after the company’s growth and product ramp, supporting momentum trading into new highs.
summary: The market is mainly reacting to a strong Q1 2026 beat-and-raise plus an accelerating Scorpio product ramp in AI data-center connectivity. That fundamental upside has been reinforced by a broad AI semiconductor bid, which has helped push the stock into breakout territory and keep momentum buyers involved. I did not find a single new named-hyperscaler contract in the provided results that clearly explains the entire 5d/20d move on its own; this looks like a combination of earnings-driven re-rating and sector sympathy.
